title: The 50/30/20 Budget Explained Simply (With a Real Example)
description:
The 50/30/20 budget is the simplest way to decide where your paycheck goes, and this video explains it step by step with a real $3,000 example.

You'll learn how the 50/30/20 rule splits your take-home pay into needs, wants, and savings, what really counts as a need, and what to do when your needs take more than 50% of your income, for example with high rent or a low income. We also cover how to check your real spending, simple ways to shrink your fixed costs, how to automate the plan on payday, and three common budgeting mistakes.
